description: Independent facts and queries written before inspecting score-gap results. Includes single-fact, compositional, and abstention requests.

facts.title: Cypress recovery verification
facts.body: After restoring Cypress backups, compare the signed manifest before starting readers.

facts.title: Cypress backup encryption
facts.body: Encrypt Cypress backups using the managed vault key before upload. Reject an unencrypted archive.

facts.title: Invoice import amount rounding
facts.body: Round imported invoice amounts to two decimal places using decimal arithmetic, never binary floating point.

facts.title: Invoice import duplicate handling
facts.body: Reject repeated document identifiers during invoice import. Do not sum duplicate records.

facts.title: Screen reader focus after modal dismissal
facts.body: Return keyboard focus to the original trigger after closing a modal so screen reader users can continue.

facts.title: Reduced motion transitions
facts.body: Disable animated transitions when the user requests reduced motion.
